instruction: Enable Do Not Disturb mode and also disable lock screen notifications on this Ubuntu system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled Do Not Disturb mode by navigating system tray → Settings → Notifications → toggling the Do Not Disturb switch on. Completed in 5 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open system tray, navigate to Settings app, find Notifications section, toggle switches in GNOME Settings
metadata.task_rationale: Multi-step variation requiring the agent to toggle TWO settings in the Notifications panel. Harder than original since it requires two distinct actions in the same area.
metadata.explanation: Task requires both enabling Do Not Disturb (show-banners=false) and disabling lock screen notifications (show-in-lock-screen=false). Custom getter reads both gsettings values. Custom metric gives 0.5 partial credit for each correct toggle.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads both gsettings keys (show-banners and show-in-lock-screen) via bash commands, which are accessible without UI state dependency
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — accesses expected.get('expected_show_banners') directly without incorrect nested 'rules' access
Both instruction requirements are fully covered: DND (show-banners=false) and lock screen notifications (show-in-lock-screen=false)
Partial credit scoring (0.5 each) is well-designed for the two independent settings
Expected values ('false' as strings) match gsettings output format for boolean settings
Preconfig correctly resets show-banners to true to ensure a known starting state
